description: Na₃MnO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.63 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.58 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.81 Å. Mn is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.96 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Mn atom to form distorted ONa₅Mn octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Mn octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₆Mn pentagonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Mn octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₆Mn pentagonal bipyramid, and faces with two equivalent ONa₆Mn pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. In the third O site, O is bonded to six Na and one Mn atom to form distorted ONa₆Mn pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₅Mn octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Mn octahedra, edges with three equivalent ONa₆Mn pentagonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent ONa₅Mn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-60°.
